summary: Frontend retest complete. Gate infinite-loop is FIXED (Gate() now uses seg0=segments[0] as dep instead of the whole segments array, and app/trip/new.tsx no longer exists so /trip/new resolves to app/trip/[id].tsx). All requested UI flows work end-to-end with zero console errors across the run. Verified: (1) Today screen — net-profit hero, Accrual/Cash toggle switches values, 4 chips (Trips, Own/Rented, New Pending, All Pending), entries list, FAB visible; (2) Add Trip — FAB opens /trip/new, tap KA-XX-1288 chip auto-fills driver Rahul and prefills Bhatta ₹600, entering revenue 30000 / received 12000 gives live Pending ₹18,000 and Margin ₹29,400 (= 30000 - 600 bhatta), Save Trip returns to Today and TEST9901 · KA-XX-1288 shows in today's entries with ₹30,000 / m ₹29,400; (3) Overhead FAB — secondary FAB (testID='fab-overhead') opens overhead-form-screen with 22 category chips, picking one + amount 1250 saves and appears on Today as 'Overhead · <cat>' -₹1,250 with Today totals recalculated; (4) P&L (/pnl) — pnl-screen renders Aug 2026 header, Net Profit / (Loss) card, section headings A. INCOME (Revenue To Pay, Return/Adjustments, TOTAL INCOME (A)), B. EXPENSES with collapsible Per-Trip category rows (Bhatta, Hamali, Diesel HBL, Attach Commission, ...), Overhead, Memorandum, Vehicle summary and Export button; (5) More (/more) — more-screen shows profile & role badge 'admin', all 5 master links (Vehicles, Drivers, Parties, Categories, Excel), Sign Out (testID='signout-btn'); (6) Masters > Vehicles — master-vehicles list shows all 10 seeded vehicles (6 Own + 4 Rented) with driver name and EMI; master-add opens modal, added TEST-KA-99-9999 Own EMI 1000 saved & appeared in list, edited model field and saved (200), master-delete removed the row (confirmed via API GET, vehicle absent); (7) Trips tab — trips-screen lists trips including TEST9901, tapping opens trip form pre-filled with TS='TEST9901' Revenue='30000'. Zero 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors were observed across every navigation transition tested (Today→trip/new→Today, tab switches Today↔Trips↔P&L↔More, master screen navigation, modal open/close).

issues: Bottom tabs do not carry testID props (tab-today/tab-trips/tab-pnl/tab-more). Not a functional bug — deep-linking (/, /trips, /pnl, /more) works — but adding testID improves automated tap-testing.

react_native_issues.issue: Still emits deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (fab styles). Also present in overhead FAB. Web-preview only warning; native builds should still migrate.
Runtime deprecation warning at least once during first render: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Grep for `pointerEvents=` prop usage in components.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Add testID to Tabs.Screen entries in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (e.g. tabBarButtonTestID: 'tab-today') so QA can tap bottom-tabs directly.
Migrate remaining 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to boxShadow in app/(tabs)/index.tsx FAB styles.
Locate and remove the last props.pointerEvents usage (migrate to style.pointerEvents). Suggest grepping: grep -rn 'pointerEvents=' /app/frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: Gate() fix is correct and minimal — seg0=segments[0] as dep prevents the every-render new-array-reference re-fire. Good.
Deleting the redundant static app/trip/new.tsx eliminated the /trip/new → /trip/[id] redirect loop. Confirmed only app/trip/[id].tsx remains.

trip/[id].tsx: after Save Trip we call router.back(). If the user reached the form via a deep-link with no history, router.back() may leave the app in an empty state; consider router.replace('/(tabs)') as fallback.
MasterListScreen delete uses window.confirm on web (implicit) — dialog handler in tests must accept(). No user-facing bug.
trip/[id].tsx line 66-67: date filed accepts free text ('YYYY-MM-DD'). No client-side validation; server accepts anything. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (Today, Add Trip incl. auto-fill & live calcs & save persistence, Overhead FAB, P&L, More with role badge & links, Vehicles CRUD add+edit+delete, Trips list & edit prefill). Zero infinite-loop errors.

Overhead: overhead-form-screen, oh-cat-<id>, oh-amount, save-overhead-btn. Today FAB: fab-add, fab-overhead. Everything is stable; only cosmetic deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents) remain.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 'Maximum update depth exceeded' — RCA (confirmed fixed in iter 2): useSegments() returns a fresh array on every render, so `[user, loading, segments, router]` deps caused Gate's useEffect to re-run every render; router.replace triggered another render → infinite loop, cascaded by static app/trip/new.tsx colliding with dynamic [id]='new' route → oscillating redirects. Fix applied in _layout.tsx: extracted `const seg0 = segments[0]` and used `[user, loading, seg0, router]` deps, and deleted app/trip/new.tsx. Re-verified: 0 loop errors across all navigations tested.
